diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.fargate is redundant — already implied by attribute references

aws_autoscaling_group.ng already depends on aws_iam_role.ng transitively through aws_launch_template.ng -> aws_iam_instance_profile.ng -> aws_iam_role.ng, as well as through its required policy attachments. The explicit role dependency is redundant.

aws_autoscaling_group.ng references aws_launch_template.ng[each.key].id and .latest_version in its mixed_instances_policy, already establishing the launch-template dependency. The explicit depends_on entry duplicates that ordering.
aws_eks_node_group.ng references aws_iam_role.ng.0.arn in node_role_arn, so its explicit depends_on on aws_iam_role.ng is redundant. Keep the separate policy-attachment dependencies.

aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate references aws_iam_role.fargate.0.arn in pod_execution_role_arn, already establishing the role dependency. Its explicit depends_on on aws_iam_role.fargate is redundant; the policy-attachment dependency is still needed.

time_sleep.wait explicitly waits for aws_autoscaling_group.ng and aws_eks_node_group.ng, both of which already depend on aws_eks_cluster.cp. Its additional direct depends_on on aws_eks_cluster.cp duplicates that transitive ordering.

When enable_ssm is true, aws_autoscaling_group.ng launches instances whose user data installs and starts the SSM agent, but it does not wait for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm-managed. Referencing the instance profile and role does not wait for this separate attachment. Add the attachment to depends_on so the configured SSM permissions are attached before instances begin SSM registration.

When enable_ssm is true, aws_eks_node_group.ng uses user data that installs and starts the SSM agent, but no dependency orders it after aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm-managed. The node_role_arn reference only waits for the role, not this attachment. Add the attachment to depends_on so the configured SSM permissions are attached before managed instances begin SSM registration.
